item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Areas of fog again overnight that will impact morning commute
item.description: We're in for another night of foggy areas that will impact the morning commute. Temperatures will start off in the 30s and 40s.

item.title: Countdown begins for Super Bowl as big economic, cultural boost expected in Bay Area
item.description: The president of the Bay Area Host Committee says the Super Bowl, as well as next summer's World Cup will bring hundreds of millions of dollars into our region and fill as many as 400,000 hotel rooms.

item.title: Trump signs executive order blocking states from enforcing their own regulations around AI
item.description: President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order that blocks states from enforcing their own regulations around artificial intelligence and instead aims to create a "single national framework" for AI.

item.title: Humanoids Summit Silicon Valley 2025 highlights accessible robotics for all
item.description: Making safe and regulated humanoids is a core mission of the summit and participants.

item.title: NASCAR settles antitrust lawsuit filed by Michael Jordan's 23XI Racing team and Front Row
item.description: The settlement was announced Thursday after a delay on the ninth day of the trial.

item.title: Deborah Cox, Andra Day celebrate 'Waiting to Exhale' milestone with live musical event
item.description: Feel the music. Feel the story. Deborah Cox, Andra Day and more to perform live in celebration of "Waiting to Exhale's" 30th anniversary.

item.title: Anheuser-Busch closing Fairfield Budweiser facility in early 2026, mayor says
item.description: The Budweiser plant in Fairfield is closing after nearly 50 years in business.

item.title: Congress gridlocked as Affordable Care Act subsides set to expire, driving up health care costs
item.description: Several bipartisan bills in the House aim to prevent those circumstances, including a proposal from Rep. Sam Liccardo, D-San Jose, and Rep. Kevin Kiley, R-Rocklin, to extend ACA tax credits for two more years without increasing the deficit.

item.title: 'Blood all over': Witnesses describe seeing victims walk out of home after Hayward explosion
item.description: "They looked in shock and easily that the explosion took out their ear drum - I assume - because people were trying to talk to them and they were not really hearing it," said Oscar Vazquez, a Hayward resident.

item.title: Shocking video shows massive Hayward building explosion after gas line rupture; 6 injured
item.description: At least six people were transported to the hospital Thursday morning after a damaged gas line caused a massive building explosion and large fire in Hayward, officials say. Dramatic footage captured by a doorbell camera shows the moments of the explosion.
